description: Haltestellen des ÖPNV (VAG) in Freiburg i. Br. is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Der Geodatensatz enthält die Standorte der Haltestellen des ÖPNV (Bus und Straßenbahn) in Freiburg im Breisgau, die von der Freiburger Verkehrs AG (VAG) angefahren werden. Die Rohdaten werden von der VAG über die Datenschnittstelle der Nahverkehrsgesellschaft Baden-Württemberg mbh (NVBW) bereit gestellt. Die Daten sind "Open Data". Coverage: Open Data Baden-Württemberg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Its tags are freiburg-im-breisgau, haltestelle, nahverkehr, opendata, personennahverkehr. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
